plugins.name: luci-app-openclash
plugins.desc: OpenClash 代理客户端(mihomo 内核,官方 APK,含全部依赖)
plugins.cmd: apk add --allow-untrusted bash dnsmasq-full curl ca-bundle ip-full ruby ruby-yaml kmod-tun kmod-inet-diag unzip kmod-nft-tproxy luci-compat luci luci-base && wget -q -O /tmp/openclash.apk '{URL}' && apk add -q --force-overwrite --clean-protected --allow-untrusted /tmp/openclash.apk && rm -f /tmp/openclash.apk

plugins.name: luci-app-daed
plugins.desc: daed 大鹅代理客户端(dae 内核,核心按路由器架构自动匹配)
plugins.cmd: . /etc/openwrt_release; R="releases/$DISTRIB_RELEASE"; [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ] && R="snapshots"; B=$(grep -hoE "https?://[^ \"]+/(releases|snapshots)" /etc/apk/repositories /etc/apk/repositories.d/*.list 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed "s#/\(releases\|snapshots\)\$##"); [ -z "$B" ] && B="https://downloads.openwrt.org"; T="$B/$R/targets/$DISTRIB_TARGET/packages/packages.adb"; grep -rqF "$T" /etc/apk/repositories /etc/apk/repositories.d/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$T" >> /etc/apk/repositories; apk update --allow-untrusted && A=$(apk --print-arch); case "$A" in aarch64*) F=aarch64_generic;; x86_64) F=x86_64;; i386|x86) F=i386_pentium4;; *) echo "不支持的架构 $A"; exit 1;; esac && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_core.apk 'https://github.com/QiuSimons/luci-app-daed/releases/download/daed_2026.07.31-r1/daed-2026.07.31-r1-'"$F"'-openwrt-25.12.apk' && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_luci.apk '{URL}' && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_i18n.apk 'https://github.com/QiuSimons/luci-app-daed/releases/download/daed_2026.07.31-r1/luci-i18n-daed-zh-cn-25.283.11553.bce4b5f-openwrt-25.12.apk' && apk add --allow-untrusted /tmp/daed_core.apk /tmp/daed_luci.apk /tmp/daed_i18n.apk && rm -f /tmp/daed_*.apk

plugins.name: luci-app-passwall
plugins.desc: PassWall 代理客户端(主程序+中文翻译+依赖自动从 SourceForge 按架构补齐)
plugins.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && . /etc/openwrt_release; R=$(echo "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" | cut -d. -f1); V="packages-$R.12"; [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ] && V="snapshots"; RSS="https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/rss?path=/releases/$V/$DISTRIB_ARCH/passwall_packages"; L=$(wget -q --user-agent="Mozilla/5.0" -O- "$RSS"); for d in dns2socks ipt2socks pdnsd-alt microsocks tcping chinadns-ng haveged; do u=$(echo "$L" | grep -o "https://sourceforge.net[^\"'< ]*/$d-[0-9][^\"'< ]*\.apk/download" | head -1); if [ -n "$u" ]; then wget -q --user-agent="Mozilla/5.0" -O "$d.apk" "$u" && echo "[依赖] 已下载 $d"; else echo "[依赖] 未找到 $d"; fi; done; wget -q -O passwall.apk '{URL}' && wget -q -O passwall_i18n.apk 'https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall/releases/download/26.10.22-2/25.12%2B_luci-i18n-passwall-zh-cn-26.10.22.apk' && apk add --allow-untrusted --force-overwrite *.apk; s=$?; cd /; rm -rf /tmp/pw; exit $s

plugins.name: luci-app-passwall2
plugins.desc: PassWall2 代理客户端(主程序+中文翻译+依赖自动从 SourceForge 按架构补齐)
plugins.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/pw2 && cd /tmp/pw2 && . /etc/openwrt_release; R=$(echo "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" | cut -d. -f1); V="packages-$R.12"; [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ] && V="snapshots"; RSS="https://sourceforge.net/projects/openwrt-passwall-build/rss?path=/releases/$V/$DISTRIB_ARCH/passwall_packages"; L=$(wget -q --user-agent="Mozilla/5.0" -O- "$RSS"); for d in dns2socks ipt2socks pdnsd-alt microsocks tcping chinadns-ng haveged; do u=$(echo "$L" | grep -o "https://sourceforge.net[^\"'< ]*/$d-[0-9][^\"'< ]*\.apk/download" | head -1); if [ -n "$u" ]; then wget -q --user-agent="Mozilla/5.0" -O "$d.apk" "$u" && echo "[依赖] 已下载 $d"; else echo "[依赖] 未找到 $d"; fi; done; wget -q -O passwall2.apk '{URL}' && wget -q -O passwall2_i18n.apk 'https://github.com/Openwrt-Passwall/openwrt-passwall2/releases/download/26.10.20-1/luci-i18n-passwall2-zh-cn-26.10.20.apk' && apk add --allow-untrusted --force-overwrite *.apk; s=$?; cd /; rm -rf /tmp/pw2; exit $s

plugins.name: luci-app-smartdns
plugins.desc: SmartDNS 智能分流 DNS(核心按路由器架构自动匹配,含中文界面)
plugins.cmd: A=$(apk --print-arch); case "$A" in x86_64) F=x86_64;; aarch64*) F=aarch64;; arm*) F=arm;; mipsel*) F=mipsel;; mips*) F=mips;; i386|x86) F=x86;; *) echo "不支持的架构 $A"; exit 1;; esac && wget -q -O /tmp/smartdns_core.apk 'https://github.com/pymumu/smartdns/releases/download/Release48.4/smartdns.1.2026.08.05-0921.'"$F"'-openwrt-all.apk' && wget -q -O /tmp/smartdns_luci.apk '{URL}' && apk add --allow-untrusted /tmp/smartdns_core.apk /tmp/smartdns_luci.apk && rm -f /tmp/smartdns_*.apk

plugins.name: luci-theme-argon
plugins.desc: Argon 主题(含配置面板与中文翻译)
plugins.cmd: wget -q -O /tmp/argon.apk '{URL}' && wget -q -O /tmp/argon_cfg.apk 'https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/releases/download/v3.1.0/luci-app-argon-config-3.1.0-r1.apk' && wget -q -O /tmp/argon_i18n.apk 'https://github.com/jerrykuku/luci-theme-argon/releases/download/v3.1.0/luci-i18n-argon-config-zh-cn-3.1.0-r1.apk' && apk add --allow-untrusted /tmp/argon.apk /tmp/argon_cfg.apk /tmp/argon_i18n.apk && rm -f /tmp/argon*.apk

plugins.name: arcane
plugins.desc: Arcane Docker 管理面板(自动安装 dockerd 并部署容器,Web 端口 3552,镜像来自 Docker Hub)
plugins.cmd: apk add --allow-untrusted dockerd docker && /etc/init.d/dockerd start && sleep 2 && docker rm -f arcane 2>/dev/null; KEY=$(head -c 24 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); docker run -d --name arcane --restart unless-stopped -p 3552:3552 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v arcane-data:/app/data -e ENCRYPTION_KEY="$KEY" -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai getarcaneapp/manager:latest && echo "ARCANE_OK 面板地址: http://路由器IP:3552"
